I will keep this small rented plot simple this season. I will plant my local cassava stems and use some manure if I can get it, because fertilizer and chemicals cost money and I do not have much to spend. Since I am in the South South and depend on the rains, I will not irrigate, and because of my age I will need some outside help for the heavier work.
